sentences: The Grundy value of an impartial game contains more information than whether the current player can force a win.
The imported question asks for a general efficient reduction from computing that value to determining a winner.
The source exhibits a sharp separation for Undirected Geography, where winner determination is efficient but Grundy computation is PSPACE-complete.
That result supplies a complexity-theoretic obstruction to the proposed general reduction.
The project explains why composing individually tractable games may require information much harder to obtain than their separate win-loss outcomes.
